about: Cost floors for every tag Pantrywork writes into (SapperSquad 2026-09-13: apply the cost floor strictly, everywhere). Read by tools/CostFloor.ps1 for GenerateBridges.ps1 (derives PASS/GATE/EXCLUDE per emitted entry) and AuditRoles.ps1 (fails if any Pantrywork path delivers an item below a floor without a satisfying gate). Source of every number: tools/work/cost-census.md (recipes read from the jars) plus its adversarial verification. Costs are strings 'a/b' or numbers.
conventions: cost = cheapest route through the item's OWN mod plus vanilla/platform, in the base unit of its category; yields count; tools are not consumed; returned containers cost 0

side ingredients: a whole side item (egg, crop, butter portion, honey bottle) weighs 0.25 of a base unit, a trace side (sugar, salt, water, kelp, pasta, glass bottle) 0.10; meat, fish, dough, flour, pasta, bread, toast, juice and jelly costs include sides ('eff' in the census)

dairy (milk, cheese, butter) is costed on milk content only; plant milks (Croptopia soy milk, Bountiful Fares coconut milk, Meadow grain milk/cheese) contain no milk, cost 0 and are never used as a floor (verifier MISSED|method: the single stated convention; under it the croptopia:cheese / croptopia:butter exclusions and the Pam's-cheese gate in c:cheeses stand)
raw gathered produce, a whole caught fish and a whole raw meat drop are 1 unit; a cut or portion is its share of that unit

floor(M,T) = the cheapest item mod M lists in T itself, directly or through M's own refs as they resolve in a pack, Pantrywork entries excluded; 'neoforge' stands for the platform convention tags (NeoForge / Fabric API) and is always present
salt: every route consumes water or common stone, both infinite; the salt floors measure processing effort, not scarcity (verifier: a units judgment, not a measured scarcity gap)

a dual-route item is costed on its CHEAPEST route, plant routes included: croptopia:ground_pork presses #croptopia:pork_replacements = [porkchop, tofu], and tofu is a soybean + water bottle, so ground pork costs 0 meat exactly as soy milk costs 0 milk

a melon slice is raw gathered produce, 1 unit wherever it appears (SapperSquad FC2-4: 'raw gathered produce = 1 base unit'; a slice is what breaking a melon block drops, so the block is not the unit), juices included: Pam's melon juice (2 slices) 2 fruit, Croptopia's (1 slice, its bottle returned) 1

a container costs 0 when the item gives it back: an item whose own craftRemainder is its container returns it in every crafting recipe that consumes it. Croptopia's juices (Juice -> new Drink(...craftRemainder(Items.GLASS_BOTTLE)), croptopia 4.2.4 and every 26.x build) and Brewin' & Chewin's jams (JamJarItem ... craftRemainder(Items.GLASS_BOTTLE), BrewinAndChewin 4.5.0) return their glass bottle, and their only Pam's readers are minecraft:crafting_shapeless (final check FC1-1, 2026-09-13). Water, milk or honey carried in a bottle or bucket is a side ingredient and still counts: croptopia:dough, farm_and_charm:dough, farm_and_charm:farmers_bread, pamhc2foodcore:doughitem/saltitem and refurbished_furniture:dough charge the water, not the container (re-checked; no verdict moves)
judgments: c:foods/milk (review CF-1, 2026-09-13): NO Farmer's Delight floor. FD 1.3.2 (NeoForge 1.21.1) and FD Refabricated 3.3.3 / 3.6.x do not define the tag; only FD Refabricated 3.4.2 (Fabric 1.21.10) still lists its own bottle there, and the only scanned readers (Bountiful Fares' cocoa_cake and its minecraft:cake override, 3 milk each) have no 1.21.10 build. So the floor is BF's bucket (coconut milk is a plant milk), FD's 1/4 bottle is EXCLUDEd (x4.00) and Pantrywork's shim holds minecraft:milk_bucket only. The tag stays defined, so addon recipes that name it still parse; on 1.21.10 FD's own file still adds its bottle (FD's call). SapperSquad's decision: FD's bottle out of bucket-milk recipes.

minecraft:melon_slice in c:fruits (FC2-4, 2026-09-13; replaces the first pass's conservative 1/5-of-a-block EXCLUDE): SapperSquad's rule is raw gathered produce = 1 base unit, and the slice is the melon's gathered drop, so it costs 1 produce and PASSes against both apple floors (x1.00). The melon BLOCK stays out of every tag by the non-food denylist.

melon juices (review CF-4, final check FC1-1, re-derived FC2-4): costed in slices, one slice = one gathered unit, consistent with c:fruits. The glass bottle is Croptopia's juice's craftRemainder and comes back in Pam's shapeless melon jelly, popsicle and smoothie, so it costs 0 (FC1-1): Croptopia's melon juice is 1 against Pam's 2 (x2.00). Pam's is the only mod defining c:juices/melonjuice, so nothing rescues it: EXCLUDE (0.6.0 shipped it). Under the slice = 1 unit the verdict no longer hinges on the bottle: CF-4's charged bottle (1.1) would also fail, at x1.82. Croptopia's apple juice (one whole apple vs Pam's two) stays EXCLUDE at x2.00.

croptopia:ground_pork (review CF-3): 0 meat on its tofu route -> EXCLUDE from Pam's c:groundmeats/groundpork (floor: groundporkitem, grinder + porkchop -> 2), read by Pam's basic pork sandwich and, through Pam's own #c:groundmeats, the meatloaf. 0.6.0 shipped this bridge. Pam's ground pork still enters Croptopia's c:ground_pork (Croptopia's floor is its own 0-meat ground pork).

c:cheeses pamhc2foodcore:cheeseitem and c:salts pamhc2foodcore:saltitem: verifier PLAUSIBLE (PASS equally defensible); the conservative GATE croptopia is taken. Croptopia is the only reader of c:cheeses, so the cheese gate changes no recipe.

meadow:cooked_buffalo_meat: strict own-mod costing (Meadow's pot makes 4 per raw buffalo meat) -> EXCLUDE from c:foods/cooked_meat. Verifier: Meadow's pot is 4:1 only for beef and chicken, 2:1 for the rest.

c:cookedfish / c:cooked_fishes / c:foods/cooked_fish have no recipe consumer. The first two keep whole-fish floors only so cut removals stay applied (SapperSquad's decision); c:foods/cooked_fish is moot.

End's Delight cuts (1/3 dragon meat, 1/2 shulker meat) are GATE farmersdelight in c:foods/raw_meat and c:foods/cooked_meat, always satisfied: End's Delight declares farmersdelight required, so they PASS by dependency-rescue.

SEEDS (0.8.0, settled after the 0.8.0 refutation pass): a planting seed costs its share of the produce it is crafted from, so minecraft:pumpkin_seeds is 1/4 of a pumpkin (1 pumpkin -> 4 seeds, verified in the 1.21.1 client jar) and minecraft:melon_seeds is 1 (1 melon slice -> 1). One rule everywhere: it fixes kaleidoscope_cookery:oil (millstone, 1 c:seeds -> 1) at 1/4 olive and rusticdelight:cooking_oil (6 pumpkin seeds -> 2) at 3/4. The earlier working note that 1 c:seeds = 1 olive is WITHDRAWN - it contradicted this rule.

MOB DROPS (0.8.0): a route that starts at a mob drop is not costed as a cheaper route. Costs measure processing effort, not scarcity (the same reason the salt convention ignores how common water is), so kaleidoscope_cookery:oil is NOT 0 because pigs drop it to a kitchen knife, and hearthandharvest:jerky is NOT 0 because rotten flesh works. A whole mob drop itself is still 1 unit (minecraft:porkchop, meadow:raw_buffalo_meat, rusticdelight:calamari).

A definer that lists no item imposes no floor, so both get a {none} row rather than a code change in Test-FloorDefiners. The conduit is real but harmless: KC
'

BLUEBERRIES (0.8.0, sixth player report): all three blueberries are raw gathered produce and cost exactly the 1-produce tag default, so NO item row was added for any of them - croptopia:blueberry is a crop drop, biomeswevegone:blueberries is a bush drop that no recipe produces at all, and hearthandharvest:blueberries has exactly one producing recipe, the 9-for-9 crate round trip (9 x #c:fruits/blueberry -> 1 blueberry_crate -> 9 blueberries), which is not a cheaper route. The same reading as every other gathered fruit in this file (croptopia:apple, croptopia:banana and the rest also have no row). Consequence: x1.00 into c:fruits/blueberry, c:blueberries and c:fruits, so the bridge is an unconditional PASS with no gate and no exclusion. Disclosed rather than glossed: because the crate takes #c:fruits/blueberry and gives back 9 Hearth and Harvest blueberries, the bridge also makes BYG blueberries convertible into H&H ones at 9:9 - a conversion, not a duplication, and it exists in the other direction already between Croptopia and H&H.

biomeswevegone:soul_fruit (0.8.0, SapperSquad decision): NOT bridged - on the generator non-food blacklist beside create:honeyed_apple. It is food with a DEBUFF: nutrition 4, saturation 0.35, effect(MobEffectInstance(MobEffects.BLINDNESS, 40), 1.0f), read out of BWGItems in the 2.6.2 jar. BYG files it in its own c:foods/fruit, which the fruits category reads, so it would have been emitted into Croptopia c:fruits and reached 7 recipes (Pam fruit punch / fruit salad / trail mix, Croptopia fruit smoothie / fruit cake, Rustic Delight beignet / sweet salad). THE COST FLOOR CANNOT CATCH THIS and was never going to: a cost measures processing effort, and soul_fruit is a gathered drop worth exactly the 1 produce the c:fruits floor asks for, x1.00 PASS. Recorded here so the number is on the record and nobody later reads the PASS as permission. BYG own blueberry_pie and green_apple_pie name their fruit by exact item id, so BYG own recipes are unaffected either way.

biomeswevegone:oddion_bulb (0.8.0, LATENT - no path reaches it today, recorded because the next vegetable pass will meet it): it is real FOOD (ItemNameBlockItem over ODDION_CROP, nutrition 2, saturation 0.35) and it is also plantable, and the third seed signal would MISLABEL it as seed stock. BYG files it in minecraft:villager_plantable_seeds and in BARE c:crops - both of which Test-IsFoodEvidenceTag deliberately refuses as food evidence - while BYG own c:foods lists only the COOKED bulb (biomeswevegone:cooked_oddion_bulb). So ownSeedFiled holds it, ownFoodFiled does not, and rule 3 returns true. This is the farm_and_charm:onion case WITHOUT the rescue: F&C onion survives because F&C files it in its own c:vegetables and c:crops/onion, and BYG files its bulb in no food tag of its own at all. It is harmless in 0.8.0 only because no category reads bare c:crops and BYG defines no vegetable dialect, so the bulb never reaches a union. If a future pass makes bare c:crops a union source, or BYG starts filing the raw bulb in a c: food tag, re-check this before trusting the seed line in the report.

CORN KERNELS (0.8.0 blocker B1): culturaldelights:corn_kernels and hearthandharvest:corn_kernels are PLANTING SEEDS, not corn. Both are in their own mod's c:seeds and c:seeds/corn (H&H's also in c:animal_foods and minecraft:villager_plantable_seeds) and in no food tag of their own, while those mods' own corn tags hold corn_cob and corn. 0.8.0 shipped them inside c:crops/corn, c:foods/corn, c:crops/grain, c:grain, c:grains, c:grain/corn and c:grains/corn, reached through Croptopia's c:corn -> #c:seeds/corn reference. Fixed by Test-IsSeed rule 3 (the item's own mod is the authority), not by a hand denylist. Costs are recorded for both anyway: H&H's 1/2 is x2.00 and would EXCLUDE on its own, CD's 2/3 is exactly x1.50 and would NOT - the cost floor alone was never going to catch this, which is why the seed rule is the fix.
